name: com.snopekgames/godai
title: Godai
description: Automate the Godot Engine editor: edit scenes and scripts, run projects, manage engine versions

packageArguments.description: Use any Godot editor instance, wherever its project lives, instead of only projects under the client's working directory or MCP roots. Recommended for clients not tied to a project directory.

packageArguments.name: --project-base-path
packageArguments.description: The base path where your Godot projects usually live (used with --global)

packageArguments.name: --toolsets
packageArguments.description: The toolsets to expose as MCP tools (run 'godai mcp toolsets' to list them)
